items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Humphrey' and the interviewee does not provide any personal context or confirmation of a relationship, only acknowledging the name.

ctx.x: Yeah, the whole cane in it. Yeah, yeah. And they come to get us, uh, the carnet down there, we finished grinding, you know. Just giving a little dance down there for the people. And the Fess, and, uh, I believe I carried a, uh, uh, uh, um, that fella insurance man, there, his cousin.
Oh, uh, Humphrey, uh... Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Jules Lee was the, wait, Jules Barnes.
